headline: Caterpillar's $100M AI training pledge on a quiet Sunday
body: A quiet day. Caterpillar announced a five-year, $100 million programme to train 118,000 workers on AI, robotics and autonomy, a small plus for Shared Prosperity that nudged Egalitarian Utopia. Other endings drifted as earlier news faded. Horizon Balance stays at -2.57.
movers_note: Only small moves today: Egalitarian Utopia +0.06, from Caterpillar's training programme (+0.04) and fading earlier news (+0.02); Enslaved God -0.05, from fading earlier news (-0.05).
